nodes.name: .openspec.yaml
nodes.summary: OpenSpec metadata for the archived android-port change, recording the schema version and creation date used by the OpenSpec tooling to track this proposal.

nodes.name: design.md
nodes.summary: Design document for the Android port describing the three platform shims (file input, directories, foreground/reachability) and five key decisions including using tauri-plugin-fs for URI resolution and materializing sandbox copies rather than streaming into iroh.
nodes.languageNotes: Architecture decision record style: numbered decisions (D1-D5) with rationale, plus Risks and Open questions sections.

nodes.name: proposal.md
nodes.summary: Change proposal for porting the floppy file-transfer app to Android, outlining the motivation, the shared mobile foundation that iOS also inherits, Android-specific work, non-goals, and capability/impact scope.

nodes.name: tasks.md
nodes.summary: Implementation task checklist for the android-port change, grouped into seven work areas: launch, reachability, directories, shared file-input shim, platform services, mobile chrome, and verification.
